option_relations.rationale: Lichen planus pigmentosus does not match the clinical presentation and biopsy findings
Inverse lichen planus matches the clinical presentation and biopsy findings of well-circumscribed, violaceous, annular patches with lymphocytes obscuring the dermal-epidermal junction
Lichenoid drug eruption does not match the clinical presentation and biopsy findings, and there is no mention of new medications
Discoid lupus erythematosus does not match the clinical presentation and biopsy findings, and there are no other characteristic features such as scarring or follicular plugging
